title: Noise operator on an appended coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $-1\le\rho\le1$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, let $x$ be a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $a\in\{ -1,1\}$. The noise operator with parameter $\rho$, applied to $f$ at the point obtained by appending $a$ to $x$, equals the noise operator applied to the even part of $f$ in its last coordinate at $x$, plus $\rho a$ times the noise operator applied to the odd part of $f$ in its last coordinate at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
